messages.content: Cardholder statement forwarded by issuing bank (filed by Ben Carter, CEO): This charge was not authorized by Tandem Health. We have no agreement with this vendor and do not recognize this transaction. Please reverse it.

transaction_info.transaction_subject: Tandem Health - Milestone 1: auth + onboarding flow

documents.title: Master Services Agreement + Statement of Work
documents.summary: Three-milestone engagement, signatory and authority, payment terms.

sections.heading: Parties and signatory
sections.text: Agreement between Marcus Lee Dev ("Developer") and Tandem Health Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Company"). Signed for Company by Aisha Verma, Co-founder & CTO, on June 8, 2026, via DocuSign (envelope 4F2A-77C1).

sections.heading: Authority
sections.text: The individual signing for Company represents that they are authorized to bind Company to this Agreement.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: M1 auth + onboarding flow ($3,000); M2 appointment booking ($3,000); M3 clinician dashboard ($4,500). Each milestone is invoiced via PayPal when its pull request is merged into Company's main branch.

sections.heading: Payment method
sections.text: Company pays invoices from its PayPal business account billing@tandemhealth.io.

sections.heading: Ownership
sections.text: All code delivered becomes Company property upon payment of the related milestone invoice.

documents.summary: Day-to-day project messages between Marcus and Tandem staff.

sections.heading: Jun 9 - Aisha Verma
sections.text: Welcome Marcus! Ben (our CEO) and I are both in here. Repo access is set up under the tandemhealth GitHub org.

sections.heading: Jul 29 - Aisha Verma
sections.text: M2 looks great, booking flow is live for the pilot clinics. Paying the invoice now.

sections.heading: Aug 22 - Aisha Verma
sections.text: Heads up: Friday is my last day at Tandem, I'm moving on. Ben will be your point of contact from now on. @ben I've forwarded you the DocuSign for Marcus's contract and the M3 scope.

sections.heading: Aug 22 - Ben Carter
sections.text: Thanks Aisha, we'll miss you. Marcus, just ship M3 and send me anything you need.

sections.heading: Aug 28 - Marcus Lee
sections.text: M3 PR #212 is up: clinician dashboard with filters and CSV export. Invoice MLD-0019 will go out on merge, same as before.

sections.heading: Sep 2 - Ben Carter
sections.text: Clinicians are using the new dashboard every day. Nice work.

sections.text: Aisha Verma - Engineering Lead at Northwind Bio (started Aug 2026). Previously Co-founder & CTO, Tandem Health (2024 - Aug 2026).

answer_key.real_complaint: This is not fraud. The co-founder who hired Marcus left. The CEO who filed the dispute does not recognize the vendor or remember the contract, even though he merged the M3 pull request himself and his clinicians use the code.
